q1_issues.issue: "Be careful" is sealed as a bare state witness sk_careful_1 carrying no Experiencer or other participant, and nothing links that directive to the bumping it cautions against, so one instruction is recorded as two unrelated commands.

(Ongoing sk_move_1) is asserted for the participial temporal adjunct "when moving things around", which is none of the exactly four markers the instruction set allows for Ongoing (there is no progressive auxiliary, inceptive, continuative perfect or perception complement).

q2_gaps: an imperative with a negative-purpose / caution complement ("be careful not to V", "try not to V", "make sure to V"): only plain positive and negative imperatives are covered, and nothing says how the commanded caution and the avoided event relate
a copular imperative ("be careful") when no addressee referent may be minted — the reified state is left with no holder
notes: Definite "the stereo" correctly projects outside the seal, no addressee referent is minted, phrasal move_around is kept whole, and During's inner/outer argument order is right.
